name: devflow
description: Issue and sprint management application for small software teams

scripts.dev: concurrently --names client,server --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace client" "npm run dev --workspace server"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace client && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace client && npm run typecheck --workspace server
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace client && npm run test --workspace server
